Metadata.Goal: 让 TUI 与 CLI 通过 Eidolon actor 从普通语言完成 workflow create/edit proof loop。
Metadata.Description: 增加高层 authoring coordinator、workspace tools、分层 prompt、kernel routing 和 CLI projection。

TaskSpace.name: add-eidolon-natural-language-workflow-authoring
TaskSpace.Description: Eidolon-native semantic authoring over deterministic workflow tools.

TaskGroup.name: Authoring actor and native primitives
TaskGroup.Description: Add layered prompts, workspace primitive tool and high-level actor coordinator.

Task.name: Expose component-backed workspace tool
Task.Description: Wrap tree/read/search/diff/validate/write/delete with the standard tool component protocol.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: All operations bind the runtime workflow component and preserve containment/canonical write policy

Task.name: Add WorkflowAuthor actor coordinator and prompts
Task.Description: Assemble layered prompts and synchronously delegate create/edit proof loops to an Eidolon actor.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Coordinator prompt selects form and mandates canonical proof/repair/publication
Coordinator uses native actor execution and forbids external agent CLIs

TaskGroup.name: Human surfaces
TaskGroup.Description: Route ordinary TUI requests and add in-process CLI create/edit commands.

Task.name: Add AI kernel workflow intent routing
Task.Description: Tell the root agent to use WorkflowAuthor for ordinary create/edit requests without demanding internal fields.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Kernel prompt routes natural workflow requests to the high-level tool

Task.name: Add workflow create/edit CLI projections
Task.Description: Run an in-process headless Eidolon turn with the same high-level capability and no MCP/external agent process.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: CLI accepts natural-language requirement/instruction and auto form
CLI dependency tests prove in-process runtime projection

TaskGroup.name: Verification
TaskGroup.Description: Verify tool visibility, actor prompt, workspace behavior, CLI envelope and builds.

Task.name: Run natural authoring verification
Task.Description: Run focused tests/builds and scan for external CLI or duplicated authoring authority.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Native registry and kernel prompt expose the human-facing authoring path
CLI implementation has no child-process agent invocation
